messages:
maya: FYI deploy-bot signaled a regression on v3.10.1 for /embeddings (p95 +39%). It auto-throttled to 30%. Thinking: either brief hold or targeted rollback. ops, can you weigh in?

deploy-bot: [automated] Throttle applied to rollout v3.10.1. Current traffic: 30%. Trigger: embeddings_p95_delta >= 35% (5m). Suggested actions: hold 10m; split traffic to stable; manual rollback to v3.9.6.

ops-oncall: i'm available. prefer a two-step: immediate 75/25 split to limit impact, suppress autorevert, then reassess at t+10m. if no steady improvement -> rollback.

trent: prepping route split now and staging pin script for tenant pinning. also preparing rollback snippet: `/deploy rollback --service embeddings --to v3.9.6 --reason "perf regression"`

sasha: drafting a short internal note for #customers and support FAQ. keep wording conservative: "temporary mitigation in progress; we'll update soon."

maya: trent, apply the split and report back. ops, if you see error escalation also call rollback immediately. deploy-bot: disable autorevert for this rollout.

deploy-bot: [system] Autorevert suppressed by operator request. Autorevert paused until 4377779999.

trent: split applied: 75% -> v3.10.1, 25% -> v3.9.6 for /embeddings. sanity checks: logs ok.

ops-oncall: t+6m update: p95 dropped from +39% -> +27%. trending down but still above alert threshold. hold to t+12m. if p95 > +25% at t+12m we roll back.

maya: if we roll back, prefer targeted embeddings-route rollback + tenant pin; avoid global revert to reduce churn. sasha, have customer note ready.

sasha: note ready, legal looped. will post if rollback occurs.

trent: standing by to run rollback; pin scripts staged.

ops-oncall: reconvene at t+12m. if stable under +20% for 30m we'll ramp to 100% gradually. otherwise rollback and pin.

maya: thanks team. keeping this thread as the execution log.
